title: 24" Dishwasher with Advanced ProDry and 360° Max Jets Third Rack
sub: PrintShield stainless, bar handle, top controls
lead: Sixteen place settings at 44 dBA in a 7.25 cu. ft. tub, a third rack whose jets spin all the way around, and Advanced ProDry, which adds a fan to the heat and opens the door at the end. The look is yours to change, with handle kits in brass, bronze, Black Ore or stainless.

features.name: Advanced ProDry
features.line: A heating element and a fan dry the load, then the door opens four inches on its own to let the steam out. ProDry Max adds time when a load needs more.

features.name: 360° Max Jets third rack
features.line: The third rack has its own jets that spin all the way around, so mugs, pint glasses and cereal bowls come out clean inside and out. Water Repellent Tech helps it shed droplets.

features.name: 50+ wash jets on five arms
features.line: More than fifty jets on five wash arms reach all three racks, so dishes go in without a rinse first.

features.name: A 90-minute Normal cycle
features.line: Normal washes and dries in 90 minutes, about 40% faster than the Normal cycle on KitchenAid's 2 and 3 Series.

features.name: Made to be personalized
features.line: This one is PrintShield stainless. KitchenAid also makes it in Black Ore, Juniper and Porcelain White. Handle kits in brass, bronze, Black Ore or stainless are sold separately; the Porcelain White model comes with brass.

also: 7.25 cu. ft. MaxTub, with room for 10 more glasses and mugs than KitchenAid's 224 models
Filtration that cleans itself, with no filter to rinse
